seo_guides_title: AutoRig Guides: Rig Characters, Animals, Hands, Cars
seo_guides_description: Guides for AutoRig V3: auto rig characters, horses, dogs, birds, hands and cars from a model or a picture, plus Unity, Unreal, retargeting and the viewer.
guides_h1: AutoRig guides: rig characters, animals, hands, birds and cars
guides_lead: One conveyor takes a 3D model, a picture, a picture of a car or text, and returns a rigged, animated model in the viewer. Pick the guide for what you rig, how the viewer works, or the export you need.
guides_fact1: Any input: model, picture, car or text
guides_fact2: Rig in seconds, animated at once
guides_cat_intro: Every category has its own skeleton template, fit rules, skin rules, clip library and quality checks. Start with the one that matches your model.
guides_cat_biped_d: Characters, heroes and NPCs in any pose. When the feet do not stand side by side, the standing leg sets the lengths for the other leg.
guides_cat_quad_d: Dogs, cats, bears, cows and pigs get a four-legged skeleton and clips retargeted from a reference library, checked numerically.
guides_cat_equine_d: A dedicated equine template with scapula, elbow, mid-neck and leg profile joints, and planted-hoof walk, trot and gallop.
guides_cat_bird_d: Wings are rigged as wings, never as arms. A bird gets its own skeleton, skin rules and clips.
guides_cat_hands_d: A single hand, a glove or first-person arms get per-finger joints and hand clips.
guides_cat_vehicle_d: Upload a picture of a car. AutoRig segments the body, wheels, doors, hood and glass, models every part, fits wheel colliders and hinges the doors.
guides_cat_creature_d: Creatures that are not a biped or a quadruped have skeleton templates and clip libraries of their own.
guides_view_intro: Every task is one Unity WebGL viewer with an agent chat. It opens on a black scene at once and plays the rig stages while the model loads.
guides_view_blueprint_d: Press B to edit bones with symmetry. The model is re-rigged 15 seconds after your last edit, or at once with the button. Confirming the skeleton is offered, never required.
guides_view_camera_d: Jump to the face, elbows, hands, knees, feet or heels. Every control shows its hotkey; right mouse pans and middle mouse orbits.
guides_view_agent_d: One shared agent per task works inside the viewer and answers in the language of the person who created the task.
guides_view_parts_t: Review the parts of a car
guides_view_parts_d: The Parts panel shows every isolated part. Accept it, redraw it or order it as a 3D model. Paid 3D clouds run only when you press their button.
guides_view_scenes_d: After the rig stages the viewer loads a scene with baked lighting and probes: cathedral, Sponza, river glade or jungle ruins.
guides_view_export_d: A model keeps its own textures. One without textures gets PBR textures automatically. Download GLB, FBX, USDZ, ZIP, a Unity package or Blender files.
guides_wf_mixamo_d: Upload any model or picture and get a rig, animation clips and every export, with no pose to prepare first.
guides_wf_unity_d: Rig a GLB character and bring it into Unity with its animation clips. The Unity package is one of the downloads.
guides_wf_unreal_d: Rig an FBX character and import the skeletal mesh with its animations into Unreal Engine.
guides_wf_tposevs_d: What a T-pose and an A-pose change, and why neither one is required.
guides_wf_tposerig_d: How a posed model is rigged: the file's bind pose first, the standing leg as the reference, and a skeleton confirmation that never blocks.
guides_wf_formats_d: GLB or FBX: how the two formats compare for rigged characters, and which one suits your engine.
guides_wf_obj_d: Rig an OBJ model. Upload it in a ZIP together with its textures so nothing is lost.
guides_wf_retarget_d: Clips are retargeted automatically onto every new rig. Learn how to reuse the animation in Unity and Unreal.
guides_wf_img_d: Drop a picture of a character. AutoRig builds the 3D model, rigs it and animates it in the viewer; every export comes back as one task.
guides_related_p: Service pages for each format, the animal rigging page, the FAQ and the gallery of real results.
guides_cta_p: Drop a 3D model, a picture, a picture of a car, or anything on the home page. The rig and the animation appear in the viewer.
